added_failures_note: The reviewed manifest records no baseline_suite or after_suite JSON. Its readable head arm is tests-operands.log: summary line '13 passed, 1 skipped', EXIT=0, which ran to its summary so the head failure set is empty; added failures are therefore zero by set inclusion, not by absence of a measurement. No base arm was recorded, so no delta was computed, and the head arm does not exercise tests/test_current_normalisation_traced.py.

assertion_analysis.condition_to_fail: The guard reverts to the admissibility-flag test, so a traced inadmissible operand reaches float() and raises ConcretizationTypeError instead of reporting a non-finite amplitude; negative-control.log records exactly that red on both parametrised cases.
The admissible branch stops scaling by target/unscaled, so linearize returns something other than TARGET_CURRENT/2.0.
A concrete inadmissible operand stops raising CurrentNormalisationError, either by clipping to a bound or by returning the non-finite amplitude the traced path takes.
rebuild_display_flux contracts the wrong rows of the stored matrix. It does not fail if the rebuild simply returns operands['conductor_flux'], which is what leaves the matrix product unguarded.

The rebuilt field differs from the persisted flux, which happens if the conductor term is rebuilt from the wrong rows or the wrong currents; it does not fail if rebuild_display_flux returns operands['flux'] untouched, because plasma_flux is persisted as exactly flux minus conductor_flux.
The tag sanitisation or the artifact root changes, so the file lands under another name.
The payload drops the state vector or the promoted domain mask, so a later panel cannot be drawn from the artifact.
Nothing: the right-hand side is the expression the code under test wrote for plasma_flux, so it holds for any conductor term.
A real bank frame fails to rebuild from its own matrix; today the test skips at line 135 because no persisted frame exists.

0.reason: the registered boundary separation is undefined because no frame assembles a closed separatrix: 0 of 5 solves converge, which the receipt records rather than inventing a value; that is the measured outcome of the re-run

findings.text: blocking: frames_with_separatrix is 0 and every symmetric RMS and sup boundary separation is null (lines 276+), because separatrix_closed_points is 0 on all four frames that drew a fine map, so the done_when's headline measure - boundary separation on the fine-map separatrix - was never produced and the node recorded a verdict without it.

non-blocking: frame_flux_comparison.png is withdrawn rather than delivered, so the dated directory holds cohort_match_summary.png and displacement_decomposition.png and not the pair §8 names; the withdrawal is a correct application of the binding plotting rules and is recorded, but the done_when's 'both figures' clause is unmet.

non-blocking: the current-normalisation refusal is changed in product source outside the four declared write paths and is not named in the manifest's scope_extension_request, which covers only the two test files; the fix is correct and guarded, but the record understates the fence the run worked under.

non-blocking: the only guard for the forward_operator.py change is absent from the manifest's recorded gate command, which names three files and not this one, so re-running the recorded gate cannot redden on a regression of the product change.

non-blocking: the rebuild assertion cannot distinguish a field rebuilt from the conductor matrix from one returned out of the artifact, because plasma_flux is persisted as flux minus conductor_flux and flux is persisted whole; a rebuild_display_flux that ignores its response argument passes, so the matrix-product capability the node adds is untested.

non-blocking: the real-data arm skips, so _persist_frame_operands has no executed coverage and the committed receipt carries operand_path null on all five frames; the manifest's claim that every artifact's path and digest is recorded in the receipt is not true of the record on disk.

non-blocking: _conductor_response_path and _stored_conductor_response at line 1663 duplicate nova/database/content_store.py's verified content-addressed store in a weaker form; the 'digest' recorded at line 1538 is an input cache key rather than a content hash, and the load at line 1666 checks shape only, so an altered matrix of the right shape is accepted silently.

non-blocking: _display_grid re-builds the display grid that nova/equilibrium/display_flux.py:260-262 already constructs and then guards the duplication with a runtime equality check at line 1869 instead of asking the owner for the grid it will use.

non-blocking: frame_figure is dead code after run() stopped calling it, with no reference anywhere in the repository, leaving a figure the receipt has withdrawn still drawn by an unreachable function.
